topic: AI Recommendation Systems, Dual-Path S-O-R, Ego Depletion & Online Impulse Buying

dialogues.critical_question: Why model cognitive satisfaction and emotional arousal as additive parallel lines when impulsive urges peak only when cognitive comfort disarms vigilance alongside high affective arousal?
dialogues.required_model_upgrade: Specify Multiplicative Interaction (ESAT x Arousal -> UBI) and resolve cold-start impulse buying via In-Session Cognitive Fluency.

dialogues.critical_question: If hyper-personalization endogenously breeds perceived surveillance and psychological reactance, why treat surveillance reactance as a disconnected exogenous moderator?
dialogues.required_model_upgrade: Model Perceived Personalization (PP) with an Inverted-U curvilinear effect on Cognitive Fluency/E-Satisfaction, triggering endogenous Surveillance Reactance beyond the privacy threshold.

dialogues.critical_question: When platforms exploit ego depletion to accelerate unplanned checkout, what happens to long-term platform satisfaction once consumer self-control recovers and regret sets in?
dialogues.required_model_upgrade: Add Negative Recursive Feedback Loop (OIB under Ego Depletion -> Post-Purchase Regret -> Erodes Future E-Satisfaction) and hedge depletion via Cognitive Load Theory.

dialogues.perspective: Generative AI Social Agency & Algorithmic Ethics (2024-2026)
dialogues.critical_question: How do Generation 2.0 LLM conversational agents fundamentally alter consumer compliance compared to Generation 1.0 collaborative filtering, and how can ethical friction protect CLV?
dialogues.required_model_upgrade: Explicitly contrast Gen 1.0 vs. Gen 2.0 AI Agency and formulate Tiered Ethical Friction (low-regret vs. high-regret cooling-off mechanisms).
